strings.acceptedfiletypes_help: Accepted file types can be restricted by entering a list of file extensions. If the field is left empty, then all file types are allowed.
strings.default_help: If set, this submission method will be enabled by default for all new assignments.
strings.enabled_help: If enabled, students are able to upload one or more files as their submission.
strings.maxfiles_help: If file submissions are enabled, each assignment can be set to accept up to this number of files for their submission.
strings.maxfilessubmission_help: If file submissions are enabled, each student will be able to upload up to this number of files for their submission.
strings.maximumsubmissionsize_help: Files uploaded by students may be up to this size.
strings.privacy:metadata:filepurpose: The files loaded for this assignment submission
